searches.reason: Test whether the training objective limits ranking quality before adding architectural complexity. Electronics shows weak sampled training separation, while large margins elsewhere do not establish generalization. Seek efficient alternatives to binary cross-entropy and compare objective-only changes using the unchanged four-category macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Explore adaptive intent segmentation as a substantial alternative to a fixed recent-interest residual. Recent repeated behavior may signal current intent, but recency sensitivity remains unmeasured. Seek lightweight models that learn when to retain long-term preferences versus reset context, using interaction histories and timestamps.

searches.reason: Investigate directional next-item relationships that distinguish useful complements from superficially similar substitutes. Seek practical fusion of transition graphs with titles and descriptions, using text features learned locally without external pretrained weights. Treat compatibility and ownership redundancy as hypotheses, since neither is directly labeled.
